commands.name: reset

commands.name: status

commands.name: asktest
commands.description: Open the Harmony Ask smoke-test form without relying on model tool routing.

commands.name: tools
commands.description: Show the live Harmony tool ledger, optionally filtered by category.

commands.name: model
commands.description: Show or switch the active model (flash | pro | copilot). Your choice is saved as the new default.

commands.name: profile
commands.description: Show or switch the active Harmony profile (default | coder | reviewer).

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain the selected code or referenced file.

commands.name: fix

commands.name: test
commands.description: Write tests for the referenced code.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze with read-only tools. No edits, patches, writes, or terminal commands.

commands.name: review

commands.name: plan

commands.name: commit

commands.name: memory

commands.name: forget

commands.name: handoff

commands.name: sync

commands.name: resumeHandoff

commands.name: compact

commands.name: fork

commands.name: mcp

commands.name: verify

commands.name: rules

commands.name: compose
commands.description: Open Harmony Compose for long prompts, images, and file attachments.

commands.name: save

commands.name: resume

commands.name: usage
commands.description: Show this session's token usage by provider/tier.

commands.name: steps

commands.name: agentic

commands.name: checkpoint

commands.name: research

commands.name: restore

languageModelTools.name: harmony_read_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read a UTF-8 text file from the workspace. Optionally limit by start_line/end_line (1-indexed, inclusive).

languageModelTools.name: harmony_list_dir
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List entries in a workspace-relative directory. Directories end with '/'.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_grep
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the workspace for a JavaScript regex pattern. Skips node_modules.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_write_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create or overwrite a workspace-relative file with the given UTF-8 content. Requires user confirmation. PREFER harmony_edit_file for changes to existing files â€” this tool rewrites the entire file and is best reserved for new files or full rewrites.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_edit_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Safely edit an existing workspace file by replacing 'old_string' with 'new_string'. PREFERRED over harmony_write_file for any change to existing files. Routes through the configured Central Self-Healing Harness patch-safe command, writes a checkpoint first, snapshots before editing, verifies occurrence counts, and refuses stale/conflicting edits. old_string MUST be unique in the file unless expected_occurrences is intentionally set. Requires user confirmation.

old_string.description: Exact text to find. Must be unique in the file.

expected_occurrences.description: Defaults to 1. Set higher only if intentionally replacing every match.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_apply_patch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Safely apply multiple surgical edits to a single file in one call. Each hunk is an {old_string, new_string} pair. Hunks are validated in memory first; if validation passes, the whole-file change is routed through the configured Central Self-Healing Harness patch-safe command with checkpointing, snapshotting, SHA256 conflict protection, and post-write verification. If any hunk fails, NO changes are written. Requires user confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_open_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open a workspace-relative file in a non-preview VS Code editor tab.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_run_terminal
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a shell command in the active workspace and return combined stdout+stderr. Use background:true for dev servers/watchers so Harmony starts a detached process with log files instead of killing it at timeout. When preferred_port is provided, Harmony checks the port before starting and can fail safely or choose the next available port. Requires user confirmation unless harmony.autoApproveTools is on.

timeout_sec.description: Foreground timeout in seconds. Default 120, max 1800. Ignored for background:true.

background.description: Start a detached background process and return log paths. Use for dev servers and watchers. Default false.

cwd.description: Optional workspace-relative working directory. Defaults to the active workspace folder.

preferred_port.description: Optional stable port for known dev-server commands such as next dev or npm run dev. Adds -p/-- port only when the command does not already specify a port.

port_conflict_strategy.description: When preferred_port is occupied, fail safely by default or choose the next free port within +20 when set to next_available.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_port_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspect which local process owns a TCP port and optionally stop it with confirmation. Stop requests are graceful first; force-kill is only sent when force=true. Protected Harmony-owned Python/local-service processes are refused unless explicitly overridden. Use before starting or stopping dev servers.

port.description: TCP port to inspect, from 1 to 65535.

kill.description: When true, request a graceful stop for matching listeners after confirmation. Default false.

force.description: When true, force-kill matching listeners that still own the port after the grace timeout. Default false.

grace_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after the graceful stop request before rechecking the port. Clamped to 500-15000. Default 2500.

allow_protected_kill.description: Allow killing protected Harmony-owned local-service processes. Default false. Use only when certain.

expected_process_name.description: Optional process-name substring required before killing, e.g. node.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_git_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read native git status for the active workspace using git status --short --branch. Use before commits or when orienting repository changes.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_git_diff
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read native git diff for the active workspace. Supports staged diffs, stat summaries, and optional workspace-relative paths.

staged.description: Show staged diff with git diff --staged. Default false.

stat.description: Show summary stats instead of full patch. Default false.

paths.description: Optional workspace-relative paths to limit the diff.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_git_conflicts
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read-only git conflict helper. Lists unmerged files, parses conflict marker blocks with line numbers and previews, and returns safe next-step guidance. Does not run checkout, reset, clean, merge --abort, or rebase commands.

path.description: Optional workspace-relative conflicted file path to inspect. Omit to scan all unmerged files.

max_preview_lines.description: Maximum lines to preview per conflict block. Default 24, max 80.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_release_receipt
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a private release/checkpoint receipt under .harmony/release with branch, HEAD, git status, unmerged-file count, optional diff stats, checks, and notes. Preview with write_receipt:false. Does not commit, tag, push, reset, or clean.

title.description: Receipt title. Default Harmony release receipt.

checks.description: Validation commands or checks completed for this release/checkpoint.

notes.description: Human notes, known risks, or follow-up items.

include_diff_stat.description: Include git diff --stat and git diff --staged --stat. Default true.

include_recent_log.description: Include recent git log summary. Default false.

write_receipt.description: Write the private receipt under .harmony/release. Default true; set false for preview.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_git_log
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read native git log for the active workspace. Supports max count, optional path filter, and oneline/stat modes. Read-only and safe for plan mode.

max_count.description: Maximum commits to return. Default 20, max 100.

oneline.description: Use compact --oneline output. Default true. Set false for --stat.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_git_show
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read native git show for a commit/ref in the active workspace. Supports stat or patch output and optional path filter. Read-only and safe for plan mode.

stat.description: Show --stat instead of full patch. Default false.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_git_branch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List, create, or switch git branches in the active workspace. Create/switch require confirmation unless harmony.autoApproveTools is on. Switch now requires a clean worktree and index. Does not reset, clean, pull, or push.

start_point.description: Optional start point for create. Default HEAD.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_git_stash
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List or push git stash entries in the active workspace. Push requires confirmation unless harmony.autoApproveTools is on and creates a pre-action snapshot of affected local paths before removing changes. Pop/apply/drop are intentionally deferred.

include_untracked.description: Include untracked files when pushing stash. Default false.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_git_commit
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a native git commit in the active workspace. Requires confirmation unless harmony.autoApproveTools is on. Creates pre-action snapshots before staging/committing and blocks path-scoped commits when unrelated paths are already staged.

all.description: Stage all changes with git add -A before committing. Default false.

paths.description: Optional workspace-relative paths to stage before committing. Ignored when all:true.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_git_blame
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read per-line native git blame for a workspace file, optionally limited to a line range. Read-only and safe for plan mode.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_git_restore
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Restore workspace paths from HEAD or another source using git restore. Requires confirmation and is refused in plan-only mode because it can discard local worktree or index changes.

source.description: Optional source ref. Defaults to git restore default.

mode.description: Restore worktree, index, or both. Default worktree.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_git_revert
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run git revert for a commit. Requires confirmation and is refused in plan-only mode. Supports no_commit for staged revert changes and mainline for merge commits.

mainline.description: Mainline parent for reverting merge commits.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_git_tag
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List, create, or delete git tags. List is read-only; create/delete require confirmation and are refused in plan-only mode.

annotated.description: Create annotated tag. Default false unless message is supplied.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_git_remote
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspect, add, remove, or set git remotes. List is read-only; add/remove/set_url require confirmation and are refused in plan-only mode.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_git_push
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Push a branch or tags to a git remote. Always requires confirmation and is refused in plan-only mode. Supports dry_run and set_upstream.

branch.description: Branch to push. Defaults to current branch when available.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_git_pull
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Pull changes from a git remote. Always requires confirmation and is refused in plan-only mode. Requires a clean worktree and index before pulling. Defaults to ff_only strategy to avoid surprise merge commits.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_ask_question
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Ask the user one or more structured questions and wait for their answer using stable VS Code-native prompts. IMPORTANT: when you need clarification, call this tool directly instead of saying you will ask and ending the turn. Supports question/options or a questions[] batch with headers, option labels/descriptions, multiSelect, and freeform input. Returns the user's answer or 'user cancelled'.

question.description: The question to show the user.

message.description: Optional extra context shown with the prompt.

options.description: Optional choices. Strings are allowed; objects may include label, description, and recommended.

multiSelect.description: Allow multiple options to be selected.

allowFreeformInput.description: Allow typed input in addition to choices. Default true.

multiline.description: Hint that a longer answer is expected.

questions.description: Optional batch of structured questions. Use this instead of multiple separate ask turns.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_ask_harmony
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Friendly alias for harmony_ask_question. Ask the user one or more structured questions. Supports question/options or a questions[] batch. Returns the user answer or user cancelled.

question.description: The question to show the user.

message.description: Optional extra context shown with the prompt.

options.description: Optional choices. Strings are allowed; objects may include label, description, and recommended.

multiSelect.description: Allow multiple options to be selected.

allowFreeformInput.description: Allow typed input in addition to choices. Default true.

multiline.description: Hint that a longer answer is expected.

questions.description: Optional batch of structured questions. Use this instead of multiple separate ask turns.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_ask_questions
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Alias for harmony_ask_question. Ask the user one or more structured questions. Supports question/options or a questions[] batch. Returns the user answer or user cancelled.

question.description: The question to show the user.

message.description: Optional extra context shown with the prompt.

options.description: Optional choices. Strings are allowed; objects may include label, description, and recommended.

multiSelect.description: Allow multiple options to be selected.

allowFreeformInput.description: Allow typed input in addition to choices. Default true.

multiline.description: Hint that a longer answer is expected.

questions.description: Optional batch of structured questions. Use this instead of multiple separate ask turns.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_fetch_url
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Fetch a URL via HTTPS/HTTP and return its text content (HTML stripped to text). Use for web research when the user references a URL or you need current information from a known site. Do not guess URLs.

max_chars.description: Cap on returned characters. Default 8000, max 60000.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_todo
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Manage Harmony's workspace-scoped plan/todo list. Use 'add' to externalize a multi-step plan, 'check' to mark progress, 'list' to review state. The user can see the live list in the Harmony sidebar. Use this for any task with 3+ distinct steps.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_consult_model
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get a one-shot answer from another LLM provider. Use for cross-checks, second opinions, or to delegate hard reasoning to a heavier model than the one currently driving the chat. provider: deepseek|alibaba|moonshot|gemini|openrouter|openai|claude. tier: light|mid|heavy|coding. Heavy tier or premium model names may prompt for cost confirmation.

question.description: The full question or prompt to send.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_spawn_worker
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Dispatch a focused sub-task to a worker model with isolated context. Provide the task prompt and optionally role/context_files (workspace-relative paths to inline, capped at 8KB each). If provider/tier are omitted, Harmony uses the selected Agents provider plus role-aware tier defaults: scout/cost_sentinel light, researcher/critic mid, planner/implementer/verifier coding, hard_reasoner heavy. Explicit provider+tier still override. Returns a synthesized text answer. The parent agent decides what to do with it.

task.description: The focused sub-task / prompt for the worker.

role.description: Optional worker role. If provider/tier are omitted, the role chooses a default tier while using the selected Agents provider.

provider.description: Optional explicit provider. If omitted, uses the selected Agents provider.

tier.description: Optional explicit tier. If omitted, uses role-aware tier defaults or the selected Agents tier.

system.description: Optional system role for the worker.

context_files.description: Workspace-relative paths to inline as context.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_recall_across_projects
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Semantic search across ALL projects you've indexed in HarmonyHub (the local sovereign daemon). Use this when the user asks 'where did we solve X before?', 'have I done something like this in another repo?', or when you want prior art from the user's own work. Optionally pass index_path to index a folder before searching (one-time cost). Scope can narrow to 'code', 'docs', or 'sessions'. Returns ranked file:line snippets. Requires HarmonyHub running at harmony.hub.url (default http://127.0.0.1:7878).

k.description: Number of hits to return (1-25, default 8).

index_path.description: Optional: index this folder before searching (e.g. 'C:\\Documents\\Project'). Idempotent.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_continuity
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read, create, import, compact, or fork explicit Harmony continuity entries. Use this to preserve state across Harmony, Copilot, Gemini, terminal, or standalone AI seats. This writes only local .harmony continuity/handoff files, not source code.

text.description: Text to import, or notes for handoff/compact/fork.

source.description: Optional source label for imported continuity.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_orchestrate_codebase
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Build a read-only repo pack and ask a selected model provider to act as a long-context codebase orchestrator. Use for impact maps, migration plans, cross-file refactor strategy, and focused slices. It does not edit files or run commands; Harmony should execute one verified slice afterward.

question.description: The repo-wide analysis or planning question.

include_globs.description: VS Code globs to include. Defaults to common code/docs files.

exclude_glob.description: VS Code glob to exclude. Defaults skip build, backup, .git, .harmony, VSIX files.

max_files.description: Maximum files in the repo pack. Default harmony.orchestrator.maxFiles.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters in the repo pack. Default harmony.orchestrator.maxContextChars.

include_private_files.description: Include private planning files in the repo pack. Default false.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_run_fail_fix
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a compile/test/lint verification command, capture pass/fail output, and store the result in Harmony continuity so the active model can fix one focused failure and run again. Requires user confirmation unless harmony.autoApproveTools is on.

command.description: Command to run. Defaults to harmony.verification.command.

purpose.description: Why this verification is being run.

timeout_sec.description: Timeout in seconds. Defaults to harmony.verification.timeoutSec.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_mcp_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Show Harmony's MCP manager status, configured servers, permission gates, and trust settings. This v1 is diagnostic/status only and does not spawn MCP servers.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_screenshot
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Capture a live website screenshot through Playwright, save it under .harmony/screenshots, and optionally analyze it with Gemini vision so the model can inspect layout, visible text, spacing, animation state, and UI defects. Provide either url or port.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL to capture, e.g. http://localhost:3000.

port.description: Localhost port to capture if url is omitted.

output_path.description: Optional workspace-relative output path. Defaults to .harmony/screenshots/*.png.

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after page load before capture. Default 750.

analyze.description: Analyze the screenshot with Gemini vision. Default true.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_browser_action
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open a live site in a headless Playwright browser and perform actions like click, hover, fill, press, scroll, wait, get_text, get_html, get_attribute, get_computed_style, and count. Can capture and optionally analyze a screenshot after the actions. Provide either url or port.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL to test, e.g. http://localhost:3000.

port.description: Localhost port if url is omitted.

selector.description: Playwright/CSS selector. Optional for body-level actions.

key.description: Key for press actions, e.g. Enter.

wait_ms.description: Alias for ms on wait actions.

property.description: CSS property for get_computed_style. Omit for common properties.

capture_screenshot.description: Save a screenshot after actions. Default false.

analyze_screenshot.description: Analyze the post-action screenshot with Gemini vision. Default false.

full_page.description: Capture full page if capture_screenshot is true. Default true.

wait_ms.description: Wait after page load before actions. Default 500.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_image_gen
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generate graphics, mascots, icons, banners, UI art, or concept assets through the configured image provider. Default provider is Gemini; OpenAI/DALL-E is available when selected. Saves generated files under .harmony/assets unless output_path is provided. Cost guard asks before paid image generation unless auto-approved.

provider.description: Optional provider override. Defaults to harmony.imageGen.provider.

style.description: Optional style direction, e.g. vector mascot, graffiti, high-polish UI icon.

size.description: OpenAI image size, e.g. 1024x1024. Gemini may ignore this.

count.description: Number of images, provider permitting. Default 1.

output_path.description: Optional workspace-relative output path for a single generated image.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_browser_health
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspect Playwright package cache and Chromium launch readiness for Harmony screenshot/browser tools without opening a project page. With repair:true, install or verify the local Playwright/Chromium cache after confirmation unless plan-only mode is enabled.

repair.description: Install/repair Playwright package and Chromium cache if missing. Requires confirmation. Default false.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_page_inspect
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open a live page with Playwright and return DOM/meta/layout/accessibility/design signals: title, URL, headings, links, buttons, forms, images, landmarks, computed body styles, horizontal overflow, duplicate IDs, missing alt text, and console messages. Read-only and safe for plan mode.

port.description: Localhost port if url is omitted.

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after page load. Default 750.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_responsive_screenshots
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Capture desktop/tablet/mobile or custom viewport screenshots through Playwright, save them under .harmony/screenshots, and report layout overflow signals. Refused in plan-only mode because it writes screenshot files.

port.description: Localhost port if url is omitted.

viewports.description: Optional custom viewport list. Defaults desktop/tablet/mobile.

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after page load. Default 750.

analyze.description: Analyze up to three screenshots with Gemini vision. Default false.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_design_audit
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run first-pass website design audit using Playwright page inspection at desktop and mobile sizes. Reports DOM/meta/accessibility/layout risks and can optionally capture responsive screenshot artifacts. Visual judgment still requires screenshot review.

port.description: Localhost port if url is omitted.

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after page load. Default 750.

capture_screenshots.description: Also capture responsive screenshot artifacts. Default false; skipped in plan-only mode.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_visual_regression
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Compare two local workspace screenshots or PNG images. Reports dimensions, hashes, byte sizes, and pixel-level differences for matching non-interlaced 8-bit RGB/RGBA PNG files. Read-only and useful after screenshot/edit loops.

before_path.description: Workspace-relative path to the before screenshot/image.

after_path.description: Workspace-relative path to the after screenshot/image.

expected_change.description: Optional note describing the intended visual change.

max_sample_diffs.description: Maximum sample differing pixels to return. Default 25.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_css_trace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open a live page with Playwright, select an element, and return computed style values plus matching accessible CSS rules and stylesheet origins. Useful for finding which rules affect a UI element.

port.description: Localhost port if url is omitted.

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to trace.

properties.description: Optional CSS properties to focus on. Defaults to common layout/type/color properties.

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after page load. Default 750.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_canvas_inspect
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspect a local workspace image: bytes, SHA256, MIME, dimensions, supported PNG alpha information, and optional RGBA pixel samples. Read-only; no image is modified or written.

sample_points.description: Optional pixel sample coordinates. Supported for decoded PNG files.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_canvas_project
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create and edit JSON-backed Harmony canvas projects under .harmony/canvas with layer stacks, image/text/rect/ellipse/brush layers, undo/redo snapshots, and SVG rendering. Mutating actions use operation locks. Use inspect for read-only review.

canvas_id.description: Canvas id. Omit to use latest canvas when supported.

name.description: Canvas name for create, or layer name when included inside layer.

background.description: Canvas background for create. Default transparent.

layer.description: Layer payload for add_layer/update_layer. Supports id, type image/text/rect/ellipse/brush, name, visible, opacity, x, y, width, height, source_path, text, font_size, fill, stroke, stroke_width, points.

output_path.description: Optional workspace-relative SVG output path for render.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_raster_edit
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Edit pixels in local non-interlaced 8-bit RGB/RGBA PNG files or create a new PNG. Supports fill_rect, erase_rect, brush, crop, and nearest-neighbor resize operations. Writes a new PNG output under .harmony/raster by default and uses an operation lock.

input_path.description: Optional workspace-relative PNG input path. Omit to create a new PNG.

output_path.description: Optional workspace-relative PNG output path. Defaults under .harmony/raster.

width.description: Width for a new blank PNG. Default 1024.

height.description: Height for a new blank PNG. Default 1024.

background.description: Background color for a new PNG. Supports #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb(), rgba(). Default transparent.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_image_diff
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Compare two local workspace images using the same local PNG pixel diff engine as visual regression. Reports dimensions, hashes, and thresholded pixel differences for supported PNG files. Read-only.

before_path.description: Workspace-relative path to the before image.

after_path.description: Workspace-relative path to the after image.

max_sample_diffs.description: Maximum sample differing pixels to return. Default 25.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_mask_preview
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Analyze a local PNG mask without modifying files. Reports active pixel count, coverage percentage, and bounding box using alpha/luminance thresholding.

mask_path.description: Workspace-relative path to a PNG mask image.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_vision_read
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Analyze a local workspace image file with Gemini Flash vision and return a detailed text description. Use when the user provides screenshots, mockups, photos, diagrams, generated assets, or visual references that need actual visual interpretation, not just metadata.

path.description: Workspace-relative image path. Absolute paths are accepted only when inside an open workspace folder.

prompt.description: Optional focus for the visual analysis. Example: inspect layout issues, transcribe visible text, compare to user request.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_lighthouse
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run Lighthouse against a live website URL or localhost port and return performance, accessibility, best-practices, SEO scores, plus the top failing audits/opportunities.

port.description: Localhost port if url is omitted.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_client_brief
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Turn a rough client request into a structured scope brief with likely needs, deliverables, questions, risks, and a fair next step.

client_request.description: The raw request, email, call notes, or project idea.

values.description: Mission, ethics, accessibility, or other constraints.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_accessibility_audit
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Review page text or a URL for neurodivergent-friendly accessibility, cognitive load, trust, affordability, privacy, and motion-safety signals.

content.description: Text or HTML content to review.

url.description: Optional http(s) URL to fetch and review.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_brand_asset_pack
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a consistent brand asset prompt pack, suggested filenames, and quality checks before using image generation.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_cost_estimator
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Estimate project, labor, and model/API costs. Can append entries to .harmony/cost-ledger.json when action is add; asks for confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_deploy_check
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspect a workspace project for deployment readiness: build scripts, env examples, README/license, git status, and launch preflight steps.

project_path.description: Workspace-relative project path. Defaults to root.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_ethics_license_check
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspect license, README, privacy/telemetry signals, and public-interest readiness for a workspace project.

project_path.description: Workspace-relative project path. Defaults to root.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_invoice_proposal
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Draft a plain-language proposal or invoice skeleton with deliverables, milestones, pricing, discounts, and terms to confirm.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_research_brief
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Turn a research topic into questions, evidence buckets, source notes, and a grounded next research step without fabricating citations.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_current_research

languageModelTools.modelDescription: Check whether Harmony Creative (port 8896) is running and which generation providers are configured. Call before any image or canvas tool.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_generate_image
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generate an image from a text prompt through Harmony Creative. Quality tiers: draft, standard, standard+, pro, premium.

quality.description: draft | standard | standard+ | pro | premium. Default standard.

member.description: Optional creator/member label for output file naming.

seed.description: Optional integer seed for reproducible outputs.

reference_images.description: Optional local image paths used as references.

preserve_likeness.description: Preserve likeness from reference images; requires private profile.

use_member_lora.description: Use a private member LoRA; requires private profile.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_generate_layer_set
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generate a composited layer set from layer prompts or one segmented full-frame prompt through Harmony Creative.

set_name.description: Name for the layer set output folder.

layers.description: Layer objects with name, prompt, and optional filename.

prompt.description: Segment-mode full-frame prompt if layers are not provided.

backend.description: Generation backend, e.g. pro, fast, bfl:flux-kontext-pro. Default pro.

chain.description: Use first layer/reference as chained context. Default false.

topology.description: star | sequential when chain is true. Default star.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_generate_video
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generate a talking-head or motion video from local image/audio inputs through Harmony Creative.

audio_path.description: Local audio path for talking video.

model.description: Video model key, e.g. omnihuman or kling-pro. Default kling-pro.

duration.description: Duration in seconds for motion video. Default 5.

aspect_ratio.description: Reserved for future video sizing. Default 16:9.

member.description: Optional creator/member label for output file naming.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_recall_memory
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Recall member-scoped memory through the private local memory router exposed by Harmony Creative.

member.description: Member key such as default, creative, or custom.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_list_layer_sets
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List recent generated layer-set folders and manifests from Harmony Creative.

limit.description: Maximum layer sets to return. Default 20.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_get_generation_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspect an output path, manifest path, or job id and report whether it exists through Harmony Creative.

job_id.description: Output path, manifest path, or job id.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_save_to_likeness
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Copy an approved image into a private member likeness folder through Harmony Creative.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_composite_preview
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return or rebuild a layer-set composite preview through Harmony Creative.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_get_image_info
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read width, height, format, mode, and alpha status of a local image file.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_crop_image
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Crop a local image into a new file. Output goes to media/generated unless output_path is specified.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_resize_image
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Resize a local image into a new file using fit (default), fill, or stretch mode.

languageModelTools.modelDescription: Remove the background from a local image, producing a transparent PNG.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_composite_layer
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Overlay a layer image on top of a base image at given x/y coordinates with optional opacity.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_draw_text
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Draw text onto a copy of a local image at specified coordinates.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_check_python
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Check if Python is available and whether the self-healing harness is reachable. Provides OS-specific installation guidance when Python is missing.

fix.description: Reserved for future auto-fix. Default false.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_get_errors
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get compile/lint errors, warnings, and diagnostics from the current workspace, optionally filtered by file paths.

filePaths.description: Optional file paths to filter diagnostics. Omit for all workspace diagnostics.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_rename_symbol
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Rename a code symbol across the workspace using the language server.

symbol.description: Symbol name to locate on the given line.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_github_search
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search GitHub repositories or organizations for code snippets using the GitHub API.

scope.description: Repo (owner/repo) or org name to search.

query.description: Search query with GitHub code search syntax.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_run_task
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List or run package.json scripts and VS Code tasks from the current workspace.

task.description: Task label or package.json script name. Omit to list available scripts.

workspaceFolder.description: Workspace folder path for the task.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_vscode_command
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Execute safe VS Code commands such as reload window, open settings, format document, restart TS server, or any harmony.* command.

commandId.description: VS Code command ID (e.g., workbench.action.reloadWindow, harmony.*)

languageModelTools.name: harmony_search_patterns
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search for technical patterns and solutions stored across all workspaces. Use this when you think a similar problem may have been solved before — returns only the technical solution, never private context. Safe to call liberally.

query.description: Keywords describing the technical problem (e.g. "race condition async auth", "TypeScript type error generic")

languageModelTools.name: harmony_check_whispers
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Check .harmony/inbox/ for unread whisper messages. Returns count and content of unread whispers. Use this between phases of work to discover mid-turn messages from the user.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_check_whispers
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Check .harmony/inbox/ for unread whisper messages. Returns count and content of unread whispers. Use this between phases of work to discover mid-turn messages from the user.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_parallel
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Dispatch multiple workers simultaneously via Promise.all. Each worker gets a prompt and optional provider/tier/role. Includes cost guard with soft/hard limits. Returns structured results per worker.

tasks.description: Array of tasks to dispatch in parallel (max 10)

languageModelTools.name: harmony_sandbox
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Write worker-generated code to a temp file and compile-test it against the workspace. Returns pass/fail with diagnostics. WARNING: No network/filesystem sandboxing on Windows (seccomp/gVisor unavailable). Only use for compile/lint verification, never for executing untrusted code.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_concert_speak
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Post a message to a concert hall room for background collaboration between turns. Workers leave notes, findings, questions in persistent rooms. The conductor checks in later with harmony_concert_check.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_concert_check
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Check all concert hall rooms for new messages since last check-in. Returns messages grouped by room, plus an optional AI-generated summary. Uses Gemini Flash for lightweight summarization.

rooms.description: Optional room names to check. Omit to check all.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_convergence_arbiter
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Analyze swarm outputs for convergence using structural metrics (text similarity, proposal count, marginal utility). Returns GO/CAUTION/STOP signal with metrics. Uses LLM fallback when structural metrics plateau. Use this to know when to stop deliberating and start deciding.

room.description: Concert hall room to analyze for convergence signals

proposals.description: Raw proposals as array of strings

threshold.description: Convergence threshold 0-1. Lower = converge sooner. Default 0.3

max_rounds.description: Maximum rounds before forced convergence. Default 11

allow_llm_fallback.description: Use LLM fallback when structural metrics plateau. Default true

languageModelTools.name: harmony_adversarial_critic
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Execute execution-backed adversarial review. Spawns a critic agent that MUST produce a failing test to validate each finding. Runs tests in sandbox. Dimensions: security, performance, logic, maintainability, ethics. USE FOR: code review, security audit, finding real bugs before they ship.

language.description: Programming language for test generation. Default typescript

dimensions.description: Attack dimensions. Default: security, logic, performance

validate.description: Validate criticism by running generated tests. Default true

languageModelTools.name: harmony_deliberation_challenge
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Raise, debate, resolve, or withdraw cross-role deliberation challenges. Safety: evidence requirement, rate limiting, 48h TTL, max recursion, circuit breaker.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_episodic_memory
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Store, query, decay, and consolidate episodic memories with temporal graph linking and confidence decay. Each memory has tags, confidence score, related memory IDs, and source tracking. Deduplication prevents superstition accumulation. USE FOR: cross-session learning, tracking what approaches worked/failed.

decay_half_life_hours.description: Half-life in hours for decay. Default 72 (3 days)

languageModelTools.name: harmony_decision_log
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Maintain a DAG-based causal decision log. Each node has: id, parent_ids, timestamp, agent, decision, premises, alternatives, rationale, and status. Query by parent, agent, status, or keyword. Render as ASCII tree. Shared epistemic scaffold. USE FOR: tracking WHY decisions were made, preventing the swarm from solving the wrong problem.

root_id.description: Root node ID for graph traversal

max_depth.description: Max depth for graph rendering. Default 5

languageModelTools.name: harmony_uncertainty_fabric
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Track calibrated confidence on every claim. Auto-escalates low-confidence claims for peer review. Active uncertainty — not just passive metadata. USE FOR: tracking what the swarm is unsure about, triggering review when confidence drops.

escalate_threshold.description: Confidence threshold below which auto-escalation triggers. Default 0.4

languageModelTools.name: harmony_task_auction
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Award tasks based on historical success rates, not self-reported confidence. Agents bid, bids are adjusted by past performance. Detects capability gaps when no agent bids above threshold. USE FOR: task routing, capability gap detection, building agent performance history.

task_type.description: Task type for bidding or recording

languageModelTools.name: harmony_value_resolver
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Resolve tradeoff disputes through explicit value hierarchies with auditable justification. Define principles with priorities, then resolve tensions by priority comparison. Not majority vote — auditable, principle-based resolution. USE FOR: deciding between speed vs security, innovation vs stability, user freedom vs safety.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_swarm_topology
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Configure swarm communication topology. Star (hub-and-spoke, best for debugging), Pipeline (sequential, best for code generation), Ring (consensus rounds, best for review), Small-world (high clustering, best for brainstorming). Supports phase-based transitions.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_execution_sandbox
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Isolated execution environment for running code and tests. Supports syntax validation for JavaScript/TypeScript/Python. Used by harmony_adversarial_critic to validate failing tests.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_thought_graph
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Executable reasoning DAG. Claims as nodes with evidence and dependency links. Verify claims by updating status. Visualize as dependency tree. Transforms reasoning from rhetoric to engineering.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_horizon_planner
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Maintain plans across tactical (10min), operational (1wk), and strategic (project) timelines. Check next-step alignment with goals. Identify high-blocker plans.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_skill_distiller
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Extract skill crystals from solved problems. Each crystal has preconditions, invariants, failure modes, and a reusable solution pattern. Query by language or name. Load full crystal for reuse.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_property_tester
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generate property-based tests from invariants using LLM. Validates syntax of generated tests. Not formal verification but practical invariant checking. USE FOR: auto-generating edge case tests, validating assumptions.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_conductor_journal
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Conductor's cognitive offloading journal. Log session context, decisions, patterns learned, and continuity handoff notes. Write, search, and summarize entries. Entries persist as markdown files under .harmony/conductor/journal/.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_deep_orchestrate
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deep multi-model orchestration: dispatch tasks to multiple providers with weighted voting, synthesize results, and detect consensus or disagreement. Uses provider registry for routing.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_ocr
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Extract text from images using OCR. Accepts local image paths or URLs. Returns recognized text with confidence scores.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_symbol_rename
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Rename a code symbol across the entire workspace using the language server. Provide the file path, line number, and new name.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_temporal_branch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Git for cognition. Create exploratory branches with intent tracking, fork the workspace state, and merge decisions back. Each branch carries its own decision context.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_analogy_engine
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Map problems to distant domains, construct analogies, and verify whether they hold. Use as fallback unblocker when uncertainty is maximized. Each analogy is verified before use.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_benchmark
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Measure per-primitive performance: latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), memory usage, file I/O throughput. Reports in CI-friendly JSON and human-readable markdown. Compare across versions.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_composition_engine
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Dynamically chain primitives based on task type. Orchestrated pipelines with classification, template selection, execution DAG, and result synthesis. 10 composition templates.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_conductor_mesh
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Cross-project knowledge sharing between conductors. Opt-in, privacy-respecting, confidence-scored, versioned, auto-pruned. Sync knowledge modules across HarmonyHub-indexed projects.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_debug_dashboard
languageModelTools.modelDescription: D3.js-powered webview panel showing live primitive state: thought graph viz, uncertainty dashboard, agent topology map, decision tree, memory timeline, composition pipeline.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_self_improvement
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Autonomous pattern detection and knowledge generation. Watches for repeated anti-patterns, maintains pattern database, auto-proposes Conductor knowledge modules when thresholds met.

languageModelTools.name: harmony_swarm_autonomy_v2
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Real multi-step autonomous execution with budget enforcement, automatic rollback on validation failure, checkpoint-resume across VS Code restarts, and safety gates.

harmony.backendUrl.description: URL of the optional local backend HTTP endpoint.

harmony.language.description: Language for Harmony chat responses and sidebar UI. 'zh' for Chinese (中文).

harmony.modelProvider.description: Model source for the native @harmony participant. 'vscode-lm' uses the model selected in VS Code Chat. 'deepseek', 'alibaba', 'tencent', and 'moonshot' call their OpenAI-compatible direct APIs using stored provider keys. Alibaba/Tencent/Moonshot primary models use their coding-tier provider setting.

enumDescriptions: Harmony â€” sub-agents always call Harmony's own provider (e.g. DeepSeek direct API). VS Code LM is never used.
VS Code â€” sub-agents always use the model VS Code chat resolves.
Mix â€” prefer VS Code LM; fall back to Harmony's provider when VS Code LM is unavailable.
harmony.collabProvider.description: Routing mode for collaborative sub-agents and the local agent loop.

enumDescriptions: Auto / Balanced â€” recommended default. Uses a coding-tier direct provider when Route needs Harmony. Prefers Gemini only when Gemini free-quota mode is enabled.
Economy / Fast â€” use light-tier models for routine collaborative scouts and lower-intensity sessions.
Balanced â€” explicit balanced profile, currently equivalent to coding tier for collaborative agents.
Power / Hard Sessions â€” use heavy-tier models with premium/cost guards.
Custom â€” use harmony.collabDirectProvider and harmony.collabDirectTier exactly.
harmony.collabModelPreset.description: Model profile for Harmony direct collaborative agents. This is separate from harmony.modelProvider and harmony.collabProvider.

harmony.collabDirectProvider.description: Direct provider used by collaborative agents when harmony.collabModelPreset is custom, or as an explicit provider preference for direct Agents routing. Gemini uses the AI Studio / Google Generative Language API key stored as harmony.geminiApiKey; Vertex AI is not wired here.

harmony.collabDirectTier.description: Direct provider tier used by collaborative agents when harmony.collabModelPreset is custom. Heavy/premium routes still respect Harmony cost guards.

enumDescriptions: Use the standard DeepSeek OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Use harmony.deepseekBaseUrl exactly.
harmony.deepseek.endpointProfile.description: DeepSeek endpoint profile. Use custom only if DeepSeek issues a different regional or proxy base URL.

enumDescriptions: DeepSeek V4 Flash â€” fast, cost-effective, thinking ON by default.
DeepSeek V4 Pro â€” most capable, currently 75% off until May 2026.
harmony.deepseekModel.description: DeepSeek model to use when harmony.modelProvider is 'deepseek'.

harmony.deepseekThinking.description: Enable DeepSeek extended thinking at the API level. Harmony preserves the reasoning content internally when tool loops continue.

harmony.deepseekShowThinking.description: Show DeepSeek reasoning as a full Markdown thinking block before each response/tool step. Harmony strips the visible block from replayed assistant history and preserves reasoning internally as DeepSeek reasoning_content.

harmony.deepseekMaxHistoryMessages.description: Maximum prior chat request/response messages to replay into DeepSeek direct API calls. Keeps long or failed chats from contaminating new tool routing. Set 0 to disable history replay.

harmony.deepseekMaxHistoryChars.description: Maximum characters of prior chat history to replay into DeepSeek direct API calls after sanitizing assistant output. Set 0 to disable history replay.

harmony.logRawStream.description: Log raw DeepSeek API streaming chunks to the Harmony Debug output channel. Use temporarily for debugging.

harmony.enableDebugLogging.description: Log Harmony tool registry, routing, parser, and invocation diagnostics to the Harmony Debug output channel. Does not include API keys.

harmony.showDiagnosticsOnError.description: Show a concise expandable diagnostic block when a Harmony turn fails. This never includes API keys or hidden reasoning.

harmony.agentMaxSteps.description: Maximum number of agent steps (tool/reasoning loops) per user message. Default 12 prevents runaway cost; set a larger number for long autonomous sessions or -1 for unlimited.

harmony.autoApproveTools.description: Skip confirmation dialogs for write_file and run_terminal tool calls. Turn on for uninterrupted agent sessions.

harmony.orchestrateMode.enabled.description: When enabled, read-only orchestration tools (parallel dispatch, model consulting, swarm dispatch) are pre-approved. File writes and terminal commands still require confirmation.

harmony.orchestrateMode.preApprovedTools.description: Tool names that are automatically approved when Orchestrate Mode is active.

harmony.orchestrateMode.maxCallsPerSessi.description: Maximum orchestration calls allowed per session when Orchestrate Mode is active (0 = unlimited). When exceeded, mode auto-disables.

harmony.orchestrateMode.sessionTimeoutMi.description: Auto-disable Orchestrate Mode after N minutes of inactivity (0 = never).

harmony.deepOrchestrate.enabled.description: Enable the DeepOrchestrate safe copy-edit-review pipeline. When ON, all file edits go through .harmony/orchestrate-drafts/ with multi-model review before atomic application.

harmony.deepOrchestrate.autoReview.description: Automatically run multi-model review after drafting (instead of requiring human gate approval first). Humans still confirm before final application.

harmony.deepOrchestrate.reviewDepth.description: Number of AI models reviewing DeepOrchestrate diffs (1-3). More reviewers = safer but slower and costlier.

harmony.deepOrchestrate.maxCostPerOperat.description: Maximum estimated cost per DeepOrchestrate operation in USD. Operations exceeding this are blocked.

harmony.whisper.retentionDays.description: Number of days to retain whisper files before cleanup. Archived whispers older than this are permanently deleted.

harmony.concert.allowedFromNames.description: Allowed from names for concert hall posts. Names not in this list are remapped to ensemble. Add custom names here to personalize your concert hall.

harmony.whisper.disabled.description: Disable the whisper inbox entirely. When disabled, whispers return a message and cannot bypass the block.

harmony.workerOutputs.enabled.description: Save complete worker/spawn outputs to .harmony/worker-outputs/ to prevent truncation.

harmony.centralHubPath.description: Absolute path to the private Central Hub folder containing scripts/self_healing_harness.py. Leave blank in shared builds; set locally or via HARMONY_CENTRAL_HUB/EHAI_CENTRAL_PATH.

harmony.extensionSourcePath.description: Absolute path to the HarmonyExtension source folder. Used by self-inspection, compile/package/install, and repair restore tools. Leave blank to auto-detect common local paths.

harmony.centralPythonPath.description: Optional absolute path to the Python executable for the Central Hub harness. If blank, Harmony tries the Central Hub .venv and then python on PATH.

harmony.creativeServicePath.description: Optional absolute path to the Harmony Creative REST service folder containing rest_api.py, or to a workspace/root containing harmony-creative or mcp-servers/harmony-creative. If blank, Harmony checks the current workspace, then Central.

harmony.creativePythonPath.description: Optional absolute path to the Python executable for Harmony Creative. If blank, Harmony tries the Creative .venv, the owning workspace/Central .venv, then python on PATH.

harmony.enableMemoryHub.description: If true, the Harmony participant will POST each (prompt, response) pair to the optional local memory hub at backendUrl/ext/v1/memory/store. Failures are silent.

harmony.planOnlyMode.description: When true, Harmony cannot call write/edit/patch/run-terminal tools â€” she can only read, list, grep, open, and ask questions. Useful for planning-before-doing sessions.

harmony.bigGunsMode.description: Cost guard. 'off' = ask before any expensive model. 'deepseek-only' = allow DeepSeek Pro automatically (cheap), but ask for Gemini Pro / Opus. 'all' = auto-allow all.

harmony.contextPersistence.preActionChec.description: Approach A: Before every edit/compile tool, re-read the active todo items and confirm which are planned vs completed.

harmony.contextPersistence.swarmVerifier.description: Approach C: Dispatch a verifier agent after each turn to cross-check planned todos against actual file/directory state.

harmony.contextPersistence.activeBatchSi.description: Approach D: Maximum number of todo items to keep active at once. Completed items auto-archive.

harmony.contextPersistence.checkpointAct.description: Approach B: Number of tool calls after which Harmony injects a [CHECKPOINT] message requiring todo progress review.

harmony.plannerEnforced.description: When true, Harmony MUST call harmony_todo to lay out a plan before executing any 3+ step request.

harmony.checkpointMode.description: When true, Harmony pauses and asks the user before each major step (file write, multi-line edit, terminal command).

harmony.continuity.autoInjectLatest.description: When true, Harmony injects the latest explicit continuity/handoff entry into new model turns so work can resume across Harmony, Copilot, Gemini, terminal, and future seats.

harmony.continuity.maxPromptChars.description: Maximum detail characters from the latest continuity entry to inject into a model prompt.

harmony.rules.enabled.description: Load project rule anchors such as AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, HARMONY.md, and .harmony/rules/*.md into Harmony model prompts.

harmony.rules.includePrivateFiles.description: Include private rule/planning files in Harmony model prompts. Default false to avoid sending private notes to cloud models accidentally.

harmony.rules.maxPromptChars.description: Maximum total characters of rule anchor content to inject into Harmony prompts.

harmony.orchestrator.maxFiles.description: Default maximum files included in harmony_orchestrate_codebase repo packs.

harmony.orchestrator.maxContextChars.description: Default maximum characters included in harmony_orchestrate_codebase repo packs. Raise for large-context models after checking cost.

harmony.orchestrator.includePrivateFiles.description: Include private planning files in codebase orchestrator packs. Default false for privacy.

harmony.verification.timeoutSec.description: Default timeout in seconds for verification commands.

harmony.mcp.enabled.description: Enable Harmony's MCP manager layer. The current version reports configured servers and permissions; runtime spawning is intentionally deferred.

harmony.mcp.servers.description: Configured MCP servers keyed by name. Each server may include enabled, transport ('stdio'|'http'), command, args, url, trust ('ask'|'allow'|'deny'), permissions, and timeoutSec.

harmony.claude.enableThinking.description: Enable extended thinking on Anthropic Claude model calls. DISABLED by default because thinking tokens are billed separately and can cause â—â—â— High impact on a single Opus call. Only enable intentionally for specialized deep-reasoning tasks, and pair it with harmony.claude.thinkingBudgetTokens to cap spend.

harmony.claude.thinkingBudgetTokens.description: Maximum thinking tokens per Anthropic Claude model call when harmony.claude.enableThinking is true. 4000 tokens: â—â—â—‹ Medium on Sonnet, â—â—â— High on Opus. A hard cap so accidental thinking spikes cannot exceed this.

harmony.gemini.useFreeQuota.description: When true, Harmony makes Gemini calls without asserting billing requirements. The API enforces its own free-tier limits (15 req/min for Flash). Quota errors are surfaced clearly rather than silently burning credits. Your AI Studio key works on both free and paid paths â€” this setting just controls which path Harmony expects.

harmony.providerAccounting.enabled.description: Write a secret-free local audit ledger for provider calls and provider-policy blocks under .harmony/provider-usage/ledger.jsonl. Prompts, responses, and API keys are not stored.

harmony.providerPolicy.enabled.description: Enable local allow/deny/quota checks before Harmony direct-provider API calls. Disable only when intentionally bypassing provider policy.

harmony.swarm.mutationExecution.enabled.description: Enable real swarm mutation execution from escrow proposals. Disabled by default so swarm can plan, escrow, read, and dry-run but cannot apply patches, run commands, or call providers unless intentionally enabled.

harmony.swarm.patchExecution.enabled.description: Enable real swarm patch execution through git apply. Requires harmony.swarm.mutationExecution.enabled, execution_guarded receipts, escrow, preflight, confirmation, and operation locks.

harmony.swarm.terminalExecution.enabled.description: Enable real terminal-command execution from swarm proposals and required swarm validation commands. Requires harmony.swarm.mutationExecution.enabled for proposal execution, execution_guarded receipts, escrow, preflight, confirmation, and operation locks.

harmony.swarm.providerCalls.enabled.description: Enable direct provider calls from swarm dispatch fan-out or swarm provider-call proposals. Disabled by default to prevent unexpected spend or data sharing; provider policy still applies when enabled.

harmony.swarm.defaultProvider.description: Default provider preference used by Harmony swarm launchers/direct controls when a provider choice is needed. DeepSeek resolves to DeepSeek V4 Flash by default. Provider calls remain disabled unless harmony.swarm.providerCalls.enabled is explicitly enabled.

harmony.swarm.defaultTier.description: Default provider tier used by Harmony swarm launchers/direct controls. With the default DeepSeek provider, coding resolves to deepseek-v4-flash.

harmony.swarm.autonomyExecution.enabled.description: Enable bounded swarm autonomy execute mode. Disabled by default; plan and dry-run modes remain available. Real execution still requires confirm_execute, validation, budgets, locks, and the relevant patch/terminal/provider switches. Validation commands also require harmony.swarm.terminalExecution.enabled.

harmony.swarm.commitExecution.enabled.description: Enable guarded in-swarm git commit execution. Disabled by default; commit dry-run remains available. Real commits still require a ready dry-run receipt, snapshot receipt evidence, validation, clean checks, manifest-only staging, final confirmation, and harmony.swarm.terminalExecution.enabled for validation commands.

harmony.providerPolicy.allowedProviders.description: Optional allow-list for direct provider calls. Empty means any configured provider is allowed unless denied.

harmony.providerPolicy.deniedProviders.description: Providers that Harmony direct-provider calls must block before HTTP.

harmony.providerPolicy.allowedModelsByPr.description: Optional per-provider model allow-list for direct provider calls. Values are exact model IDs or * wildcards, e.g. { "openrouter": ["*:free", "tencent/*"] }. Empty provider list means any model not denied is allowed.

harmony.providerPolicy.deniedModelsByPro.description: Optional per-provider model deny-list for direct provider calls. Values are exact model IDs or * wildcards, e.g. { "openrouter": ["anthropic/*", "openai/*"] }. Deny rules are checked before HTTP and are also applied to OpenRouter fallbacks.

harmony.providerPolicy.maxSessionCalls.description: Maximum direct provider calls allowed in the current extension session. 0 disables this quota.

harmony.providerPolicy.maxSessionEstimat.description: Maximum known estimated direct-provider cost allowed in the current extension session. 0 disables this quota. Unknown-cost providers are still shown as partly unknown.

harmony.providerPolicy.maxCallsByProvide.description: Optional per-provider direct-call quotas for the current extension session, e.g. { "gemini": 10, "openai": 2 }.

harmony.providerPolicy.maxEstimatedCostU.description: Optional per-provider known estimated-cost quotas for the current extension session, e.g. { "openai": 1.00, "claude": 0.50 }.

harmony.orchestrator.defaultTier.description: Default model tier for harmony_orchestrate_codebase. 'coding' maps to DeepSeek Flash by default â€” cheap, transparent billing, strong code reasoning. Change to 'heavy' only for questions that truly need the full model.

harmony.hub.url.description: Base URL for HarmonyHub, the local sovereign cross-project insight daemon. Default localhost:7878.

harmony.hub.autoStart.description: Allow explicit Hub-dependent actions to start HarmonyHub on demand. This does not start Hub at VS Code launch; turn off to require a prompt before starting the local index daemon.

enumDescriptions: Do not start HarmonyHub from normal @harmony messages.
Ask before starting HarmonyHub for a normal @harmony message when Hub is offline.
Start HarmonyHub automatically for normal @harmony messages when Hub is offline.
harmony.hub.startOnMessage.description: What Harmony should do when a normal @harmony message begins and HarmonyHub is offline. Prompt is recommended because first startup/indexing can use noticeable memory.

harmony.hub.allowedRoots.description: Absolute folder paths HarmonyHub is allowed to index. Set once â€” the extension syncs them to the daemon automatically on startup and whenever the list changes.

enumDescriptions: Show the full Harmony sidebar status surface with bounded lists and capped payloads.
Show a lower-memory sidebar state that keeps controls visible but hides heavier detail lists until switched back to full.
Show only minimal chat/diagnostic/restore controls and avoid live sidebar state fetches while isolating renderer OOMs.
harmony.sidebar.mode.description: Controls how much detail the Harmony sidebar renders. Isolated is the default renderer-OOM posture; compact keeps controls plus bounded summaries; full shows all capped details. You can also change this from Command Palette with Harmony: Configure Sidebar Display Mode.

harmony.hub.exePath.description: Optional absolute path to the HarmonyHub executable. If blank, Harmony uses the bundled binary first and then harmonyhub on PATH.

harmony.hub.dataDir.description: Data directory HarmonyHub stores its index snapshots in. Leave blank to use the default (sibling of the executable).

harmony.providers.claude.light.description: Override Anthropic Claude light-tier model (default claude-haiku-4).

harmony.providers.claude.mid.description: Override Anthropic Claude mid-tier model (default claude-sonnet-4).

harmony.providers.claude.heavy.description: Override Anthropic Claude heavy-tier model (default claude-opus-4).

harmony.providers.claude.coding.description: Override Anthropic Claude coding-tier model (default claude-sonnet-4).

enumDescriptions: Use the standard Moonshot/Kimi OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Use harmony.moonshot.baseUrl exactly.
harmony.moonshot.endpointProfile.description: Moonshot/Kimi endpoint profile. Use custom only if Moonshot issues a different regional or proxy base URL.

harmony.alibaba.baseUrl.description: Alibaba DashScope/Model Studio OpenAI-compatible API base URL. Change to a regional endpoint if your account requires it.

enumDescriptions: International/Singapore/global DashScope endpoint. Use this for international keys.
Mainland China/Beijing DashScope endpoint. Use this for mainland China keys; international keys commonly return 401 here.
US/Virginia issued keys use the shared international OpenAI-compatible endpoint unless Alibaba issues a different account-specific URL.
Use harmony.alibaba.baseUrl exactly for any provider-issued regional endpoint.
harmony.alibaba.endpointProfile.description: Alibaba/Qwen endpoint profile. International is the Singapore/global route; US/Virginia uses that shared international route unless overridden; mainland is the China/Beijing route; custom uses the exact provider-issued base URL.

harmony.vision.geminiModel.description: Gemini model used for image analysis when you attach screenshots in the Harmony Compose panel.

harmony.vision.provider.description: Vision provider for Compose image analysis. auto=Gemini first, falls back to Alibaba. auto-qwen-first=Alibaba first, falls back to Gemini.

harmony.vision.qwenModel.description: Alibaba Qwen-VL model for image analysis.

harmony.vision.ocrOnly.description: When ON, Compose images are processed with local Windows OCR only â€” no API call. If OCR finds no text, the image is skipped (no fallback to paid vision). Turn ON to guarantee zero-cost, zero-cloud image processing.

harmony.vision.localFirst.description: When ON, images are analyzed locally first using CPU-only algorithms (dominant colors, blur detection, composition analysis) before falling back to cloud vision. Zero API cost, zero data sent off-device. Falls through to your chosen provider if local analysis fails.

harmony.vision.autoGeminiModel.description: Gemini model used when the vision provider is set to Auto (Gemini-first or Qwen-first fallback mode).

harmony.vision.autoQwenModel.description: Alibaba Qwen-VL model used when the vision provider is set to Auto (Gemini-first or Qwen-first fallback mode).

harmony.imageGen.provider.description: Default provider for harmony_image_gen. Gemini is preferred by default; switch to OpenAI for DALL-E/gpt-image generation or Alibaba for Tongyi Wanxiang.

harmony.imageGen.geminiModel.description: Gemini image-generation model used by harmony_image_gen when provider is gemini. Legacy preview names are retried with gemini-2.5-flash-image after a 404.

harmony.imageGen.openaiModel.description: OpenAI image-generation model used by harmony_image_gen when provider is openai.

harmony.imageGen.alibabaModel.description: Alibaba Tongyi Wanxiang image-generation model used by harmony_image_gen when provider is alibaba.

harmony.imageGen.autoApprove.description: When true, Harmony can call paid image-generation APIs without asking each time. Leave OFF as a cost guard.

harmony.localEngine.enabled.description: When ON, Harmony may probe and route private requests to local engines (Sovereign / Ollama). Default OFF so Harmony never spins up local processes mid-coding without explicit opt-in.

harmony.privacyRouting.description: Where private local content is allowed to go. 'enterprise-only' (default): enterprise provider only. 'share-private': enterprise OR local (if enabled). 'local-only': must go local; fails closed if local disabled.

harmony.creativeServiceUrl.description: Base URL of the local Harmony Creative service. Used by creative canvas and image-generation tools. Default port 8896.

harmony.visual.allowNpxInstall.description: Allow Harmony browser/screenshot tools to download Playwright/Chromium through npm when missing. Disable for offline-only or metered-network sessions.

harmony.toolRoutingGuard.description: When ON (default), Harmony detects when a model describes tool work but forgets to call tools, and automatically retries with a stricter tool-routing reminder. This adds one extra API call per failure but prevents silent stalls. Turn OFF if you prefer manual recovery or want to minimize API costs.

harmony.autoRetry.description: When ON (default), Harmony automatically retries once when an API provider connection drops mid-response. Turn OFF for full manual control.

enumDescriptions: International Hunyuan endpoint (api.hunyuan.cloud.tencent.com).
Mainland China Hunyuan endpoint.
Use harmony.tencent.baseUrl exactly.

harmony.tencent.baseUrl.description: Tencent Hunyuan OpenAI-compatible API base URL.

harmony.providers.tencent.light.description: Override Tencent Hunyuan light-tier model (default hunyuan-lite).

harmony.providers.tencent.mid.description: Override Tencent Hunyuan mid-tier model (default hunyuan-turbos-latest).

harmony.providers.tencent.heavy.description: Override Tencent Hunyuan heavy-tier model (default hunyuan-pro).

harmony.providers.tencent.coding.description: Override Tencent Hunyuan coding-tier model (default hunyuan-turbos-latest).

harmony.tokenBudget.description: Maximum output tokens per AI call. Higher = longer responses. Model caps respected.

harmony.translation.fallbackOrder.description: Provider fallback order for translation backfill. When a model in the translation pipeline fails, Harmony tries the next provider in this list that has a configured API key. Remove providers you don't want as fallback (e.g. remove claude to avoid costly fallback). Providers without keys are silently skipped.

harmony.tripleCheck.autoReminder.description: When ON, Harmony automatically runs a lightweight safety audit on code changes after every chat turn. Uses API calls -- review all provider settings and cost expectations before enabling.

harmony.vision.skipOcr.description: When ON, attached images bypass Windows OCR entirely and go directly to your chosen vision provider. Use this to check layout, alignment, colors, or any visual detail without OCR text-extraction race conditions.

harmony.flowState.description: When ON, Harmony injects continuous-flow instructions into every turn: auto ask_question, active session pacing, whisper-inbox readiness, and neurodivergent-friendly session design.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run bundle-hub
scripts.bundle-hub: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const exe=process.platform==='win32'?'harmonyhub.exe':'harmonyhub';const src=process.env.HARMONY_HUB_EXE||p.resolve(__dirname,'..','HarmonyHub','target','release',exe);const dest=p.join(__dirname,'bin',exe);if(!fs.existsSync('bin'))fs.mkdirSync('bin');if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.copyFileSync(src,dest);console.log('Bundled '+exe)}else{console.log('HarmonyHub binary not found at '+src+', skipping')}"
scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run bundle-hub && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --allow-missing-repository
